alias_contract.allowed: All external-role equalities that do not use a protected fixed key or violate suffix uniqueness/authority-in-suffix are represented. This includes source=recipient, source=authority, source=signer, recipient=authority, recipient=signer, and their combinations. Descriptor conformance does not prove simultaneous native type/owner/threshold/payment compatibility.
alias_contract.forbidden: Any external role equals one of9 profile protected keys; repeated suffix keys; authority key in suffix. No other blanket duplicate check.
alias_contract.runtime_unassessed: Actual owner==PROGRAM, owner==sysvar, executable-account exclusions; source native owner/mint/state/delegate/CpiGuard; destination eligibility. AccountMeta contains no owner/data/executable information. No recipient SystemAccount or recipient signature requirement.

body.body_count_rule: kind0 requires count0; kind1 body count0..11. Full source authorize rejects kind1/count0 at lib.rs240; low-level decode preserves it only to report SIGNERS_REQUIRED. Body grammar is not full program validity.

case_matrix: MATRIX.json is the mandatory initial case-ID list. Every case must map to a retained actual target invocation/result or explicit unmet obligation; no skipped positive PASS. Independent oracle cases may satisfy matching obligations by explicit mapping, no duplicate required call just for naming.

cli.arguments: Exactly one pathname; no flags, stdin, help mode, URL fetch or output file. A help probe is CLI_USAGE/2.
cli.file: read-only nonblocking open; fstat before reading; regular file only; symlink to regular target allowed; no input-requested external reads
cli.json: strict UTF-8/no BOM; no duplicate keys, JSON numeric literals, nonfinite constants or unpaired surrogates; scalar-string limit1024 Unicode characters; any overlong decoded string/key=>INVALID_SHAPE at $; nearest declared parent for unknown-field errors
cli.stdout: Exactly one ensure_ascii=true sort_keys=true indent=2 JSON object plus LF; stderr empty for specified errors. No traceback/OS text/input echo.

errors.message: Use exactly one local request file.
Input must be a readable regular file.
Input exceeds the byte limit.
Input must be strict UTF-8 without BOM.
Input must be strict JSON without duplicate keys or numeric literals.
Input contains an invalid Unicode scalar.
Input exceeds the nesting limit.
Input fields or types do not match the request schema.
errors.path: nearest declared parent or typed field

MISSING_PRIVILEGE.decode: descriptor.accounts[i]; one per role whose effective union lacks any required bit

ROUTE_KIND_MISMATCH.encode: unreachable: kind derived from declared route

findings.message: Kind-zero intent requires an empty signer suffix.
Native multisig intent requires at least one supplied signer.
Native multisig intent permits at most eleven supplied signers.
Declared authorization route differs from the body kind.
Program ID differs from the fixed historical profile.
Fixed account key differs from the historical profile.
Body recipient differs from account five.
External role uses a fixed protected protocol key.
Supplied signer suffix contains a repeated key.
Authority cannot be its own supplied signer suffix.
Descriptor privilege union does not meet the role minimum.

packaged_profile.read_rule: Read-only nonblocking open/fstat regular-file check, at most expected size+1 and close every descriptor; any failure is SOURCE_BINDING_ERROR. No profile URL/path/env override.

privileges: Required values are minima. Effective flag for every occurrence of key k is OR of that flag over this descriptor accounts. Missing false flags are never errors; true extras allowed. No signature or privilege from outside descriptor inferred. Canonical encoder emits exactly role-minimum flags per occurrence, not a deduplicated/reordered account list. Decoder preserves actual occurrence flags and reports their key union.

report.error_report: statusERROR,operation null,profile UNCONFIGURED,validation all UNASSESSED,descriptor/intent null,account_requirements/findings empty. input_sha256 exact input bytes when fully read within limit else null. profile_sha256/source_bindings always fixed embodied-version references, not successful trust attestations.
report.finding_order: ascending(path,code), lexicographic ASCII; no duplicate(code,path); fixed messages only
report.normal_report: profile LOCAL_M3_HISTORICAL_V1 and operation exact request; error null; input_sha256 exact original file bytes; all keys always present; descriptor copied exactly for decode, canonical for valid encode; intent source/authority from metas3/6, recipient from body, signers from suffix; route from declared claim only. No payout quote fields.

normal_rules.decode: Preserve all descriptor strings/flags/order exactly after structural validation. body VALID_INITIAL_BODY; descriptor NONCONFORMANT iff any layer=descriptor finding. Intent NONCONFORMANT if any finding other than ROUTE_UNRESOLVED, else UNRESOLVED for route null, else CONFORMANT. Status follows intent; any nonconformance outranks unresolved. account_requirements always all9+n roles, boolean signer requirement resolved from kind.
normal_rules.descriptor_object_preservation: Decode retains exact program_id/accounts/data_hex values and their account order/flags; JSON object key order is canonically sorted in stdout, not a lossless copy of input JSON formatting.
normal_rules.encode_invalid_intent: NONCONFORMANT/1, descriptor null, account_requirements[], intent normalized with route-derived kind and supplied count, body/descriptor NOT_PRODUCED and intent NONCONFORMANT; collect all alias/suffix/amount findings before refusing output. No invalid instruction emitted.
normal_rules.encode_valid: CONFORMANT/0; descriptor exact fixed roles+suffix with role-minimum occurrence flags; body VALID_INITIAL_BODY, descriptor/intent CONFORMANT.
normal_rules.error_paths: Missing required child/unknown key/bad object or list => nearest declared containing object/list path. Invalid operation=>operation; invalid route=>intent.authorization_route or route_claim; flag type=>descriptor.accounts[i].is_signer or .is_writable. All parser/depth/globalstring errors at $. Schema missing/mismatch=>schema. Missing branch payload or route_claim=>$.
normal_rules.finding_source_arrays: Exact catalog arrays; never change them based on current alias/claimed route. Findings are request-relative fixed paths.
normal_rules.source_bindings: Exact PROFILE.sources path=>sha256 map; no additional dynamic paths or caller assertions.

common.profile: optional; missing/null/UNCONFIGURED => PROFILE_UNCONFIGURED; LOCAL_M3_HISTORICAL_V1 only enabled; other string => UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE; other type => INVALID_SHAPE

decode.data_hex: ASCII lowercase [0-9a-f]*, even length, at most512characters (256bytes); body length checked separately. No base64/encoding alternative.
decode.metas: Required ordered list of0..21 exact meta objects; pubkey canonical; flags actual booleans; size>21 INVALID_SHAPE. Count checked against body later.
decode.route_claim: owner|pda|native_multisig or explicit null. Unknown enum/type => INVALID_SHAPE at route_claim. Null never inferred from body/keys/flags.

encode.signers: Required ordered list of canonical pubkeys, maximum12 for bounded rejected-count characterization; >12 INVALID_SHAPE at intent.signers. Zero and twelve are invalid-intent cases, not silent coercions.

stage: A design only; target calls 0; implementation gated

suffix_role.rendering: role signer[0],signer[1] etc.; index decimal9+j string; resolved required flags booleans.

typed_fields.count_output: Every amount/count/index/version/tag returned as a decimal string; booleans/null remain their types.
typed_fields.pubkey: Canonical Base58 of exactly32bytes: alphabet123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz, exact re-encoding equality,32..44characters. No curve/signability/ownership test.
typed_fields.u64: ASCII 0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19}, numeric value<=18446744073709551615. JSON numbers/bools/null/whitespace/signs/fraction/exponent/leading zeros rejected; minimum0 valid, amount0 intent-invalid.

validation_order: CLI/file byte bound and strict UTF8
strict JSON/numeric/duplicates then Unicode-scalar check then container depth/string bounds
root object/unknown keys at root then schema then operation; required branch root keys; profile type/select
fixed packaged PROFILE exact byte-length and SHA256 vs compiled trust pin; no caller-supplied source/hash override
encode: intent object unknown/missing keys; source,authority,recipient pubkeys; amount,minimum u64; route enum; signers list/type then each key in order
decode: route_claim then descriptor unknown/missing keys; program_id; accounts array and each exact object/pubkey/is_signer/is_writable in order; data_hex
decode body: exact length, header, kind, count0 coupling/count<=11, actual9+count account length
collect all applicable static findings; deterministic sorting; encode emits descriptor only if none; decode preserves structurally valid descriptor even when nonconformant
verification: Finite stdlib constructive generation plus independently literal golden bytes/meta/source evidence. No hypothesis/new package/shrinking/exhaustiveness. Full-intent roundtrip cannot recover owner/PDA route from kind0; compare wire-field projection and separately route_claim. Each externally initiated encode/decode/helper/CLI/help/error/retry prospectively counted,1024perrole cumulative, recommended<=128initial. Product has no agent budget/ledger.
